newsitem.title: USA: Geographics sued by shareholder - attys.
newsitem.headline: Geographics sued by shareholder - attys.

text.p: Two law firms said Wednesday they have filed a lawsuit against Geographics Inc on behalf of an unnamed individual who purchased the company's stock between August 6, 1996, and June 12, 1997.

The firms of Kaplan, Kilsheimer & Fox LLP and Cohen, Milstein, Hausfeld & Toll PLLC said they filed a lawsuit in U.S. District Court in Seattle against Chairman, President and Chief Executive Ronald Deans, former Chief Financial Officer Terry Fife and the company.
Geographics manufactures stationery paper, lettering, signage and graphic arts products.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
The firms said the action is brought as a class action on behalf of all persons who purchased its common stock from August 6, 1996 through June 12, 1997.

The unnamed plaintiff alleges that during this period, the defendants issued false and misleading financial and business information about the company, the firms said. In particular, the plaintiff accuses the defendants of overstating the company's gross margin and inventory, and of understating its reserves for impaired or obsolete inventory.
